title: Drash
subtitle: Independent
description: Drash was a human-cyborg resident of Mos Espa on Tatooine. In the town of Mos Espa, she was part of a swoop gang that would steal water to survive. Once Boba Fett was on to their scam, he offered them a job. Drash helped lead the efforts to save her hometown from the evil predations of the Pyke Syndicate who wanted to move in on Jabba the Hutt's criminal empire.
